name: Line
text:
#!name=Line
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partL/Line.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Rule]
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/a\.line\.me\/lass\/api\/v\d\/ads$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/a\.line\.me\/oa\/v\d\/e$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/a\.line\.me\/cs\/v\d\/oa$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/w\.line\.me\/adp\/api\/ad\/v\d\/", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/crs-event\.line\.me\/v\d\/imp", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/obs\.line-scdn\.net\/0h.+\/(o|m)\d+x\d+$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/obs\.line-scdn\.net\/0hGH\d", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/obs\.line-scdn\.net\/0h.+\/\d+p\.mp4$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/scdn\.line-apps\.com\/lan\/image\/line\/bannerImageEvent\/", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/scdn\.line-apps\.com\/lan\/document\/pageEvent\/line\/ios\/", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/sch\.line\.me\/api\/v\d\/ads$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/uts-front\.line-apps\.com\/event$", REJECT-DROP
URL-REGEX, "^https:\/\/uts-front\.line-apps\.com\/settings$", REJECT-DROP



[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/a\.line\.me\/er\/lads\/v\d\/ei\?/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/a\.line\.me\/er\/l.*\/v\d\/event\/image/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/ad\.line-scdn\.net\/0h/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/ec-bot-obs\.line-scdn\.net\/0h[-0-9a-zA-Z_]{50,}/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/gw\.line\.naver\.jp\/ext\/lgfp\/lad\/v1$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/gw\.line\.naver\.jp\/lass\/api\/v1\/ads$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/gw\.line\.naver\.jp\/tr\/event$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/lan\.line\.me\/v1\/line\/ios/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/legy\.line-apps\.com:443\/ext\/lgfp\/lad\/v1$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/legy\.line-apps\.com:443\/ext\/smartch\/banner\/sch\/v1$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/legy\.line-apps\.com\/line\.gcs\.GcsModuleService\/GetModulesByModuleIds$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/legy\.line-apps\.com:443\/tr\/event$/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/web-mmap-pay\.line-apps\.com\/tw\/liff\/campaign\/v1\/aggregate\/ad\/banner\//i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/buy\.line\.me\/api\/graphql\?variables/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/obs\.line-scdn\.net\/r\/linecrs\/.+\/m180x180$/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/d\.line-scdn\.net\/lcp-prod-photo\/20.+\.(jpg|jpeg|png)/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/cix\.line-apps\.com\/R4\?/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/scdn\.line-apps\.com\/appresources\/moretab\/list\.json/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/static\.line-scdn\.net\/ad-sdk\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/nelo2-col\.linecorp\.com\/_store$/i then reject(404)


[MITM]
hostname = a.line.me, ad.line-scdn.net, w.line.me, gw.line.naver.jp, lan.line.me, buy.line.me, crs-event.line.me, obs.line-scdn.net, d.line-scdn.net, scdn.line-apps.com, sch.line.me, static.line-scdn.net, nelo2-col.linecorp.com, uts-front.line-apps.com, cix.line-apps.com, scdn.line-apps.com, legy.line-apps.com, ec-bot-obs.line-scdn.net
